sites.reason: Pure free-form content generation. The prompt asks the model to generate a lasagna recipe; all schema fields (name, ingredient names/amounts, steps) are open-ended strings. A schema with open-ended strings remains GENERATION per audit rules. Jev is a decision model that returns typed judgments from closed sets — it does not produce prose, creative content, or arbitrary text. No embedded decision, routing, classification, or selection component exists to decompose.

options.benefit: No change, no risk. Original behavior preserved exactly.
options.risk: N/A — generation is outside Jev's capability boundary.
